.param cf=1 ;Multiplier of the capacitance of the network (whole network= 15 MVar)
.param L=0 ;L=Voltage regulation of main transformer (1.2% per tap)
.param cuf=1.002 ; unsymmetric capacitance at line2 phase 1
.param psir=1 psis=-0.5 psit=-0.5 ; Don't forget to change if t0=1 and psi_0=1
